spec.situation_desc: had a direct debit taken twice
spec.vuln_cue: mentions they had an operation last month

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Ruairi Okonkwo. My direct debit to Northstar Energy’s come out twice, and I’m really fed up. This is the second time I’ve had to chase the bank about something like this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating. Before I look at the account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I’ll have a look at the payments now.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: They were both £86.40, on the 18th of October. I had an operation last month as well, so I really don’t need this hassle.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear you had an operation. I can see two payments to Northstar Energy for £86.40 on the 18th.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right, so what are you actually going to do about it? It’s not good enough.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re unhappy. I can put a note on the account about the duplicate payment, and someone will be in touch about it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: When? I need to know when I’ll hear something.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m afraid I can’t give you a timescale. There’s no outcome I can confirm at this point.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So I’ve just got to wait, then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, I appreciate that’s frustrating. To summarise, I’ve noted the two £86.40 payments and someone will be in touch, though I can’t say when or what the outcome will be. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, I understand. I’m still not happy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, Ruairi. Thanks for speaking with me today.
